verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes product feed specs (Google Product Feed, OpenAI ACP Product Feed) via Store Sync so agents/platforms can discover merchant catalogs, plus an llms.txt and MCP server discovery surface for developer tools — but there is no single published directory/index of payable services or merchant APIs that an agent can query to discover what's payable across PayPal; discovery is merchant-by-merchant, per-catalog-feed, and gated behind form-based onboarding. missing for 10: a public, queryable directory/index of payable services/APIs (not just per-merchant feed files), open discovery without approval gating, and independent evidence that agents actually browse/discover via this mechanism.
